title: identity-morphism
description: The morphism id_A : A → A on an object that is neutral for composition — a morphism whose source and target coincide and that does nothing when composed. The unit of composition; an object is identified with its identity morphism. A morphism refined by the neutrality law.

endo.description: source and target are the same object (id_A : A → A)

neutral.description: f ∘ id_A = f and id_B ∘ f = f for every f : A → B
